2024
Ascent
Dream bigger.
When you’re ready for life’s next big adventure, the 2024 Ascent is ready to take you to new heights.
The Ascent is our largest and most versatile Subaru ever, with three rows and seating for up to eight.1
It’s packed with advanced technologies, from active safety systems to entertainment features.
And for 2024, the Ascent takes its presence to the next level—from its stylish trim and accents to
the cutting-edge look of its wheels.1
Whatever size or shape your next adventure takes, the Ascent is ready. It
features standard Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive while delivering
up to 26 highway MPG,² and it can tow up to 5,000 lbs.³ With 8.7 inches
of ground clearance and available dual-function X-MODE® with Hill
Capable
Descent Control,1 you can reach even more destinations.
When it comes to safety, Subaru never stops innovating. That’s why
the Ascent includes the latest EyeSight® Driver Assist Technology4
and LED Steering Responsive Headlights. A 360-degree Surround
Safe View Monitor 1 and a Smart Rear-View Mirror 1 are also available to
enhance all-around awareness and peace of mind.
Wherever you’re sitting in the Ascent, you can stay connected—and
with up to eight USB ports,1,5 you always have a place to plug in.
Accessing your music and apps is simple and seamless, thanks
to standard SUBARU STARLINK® Multimedia, featuring an 11.6-inch
Connected touchscreen along with wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android
Auto™ integration.
Our rigid Subaru Global Platform helps give the Ascent long-lasting
durability, thanks to its high-strength steel construction. That’s just
one of the reasons why 96% of Subaru vehicles sold in the last 10
Long-lasting years are still on the road today—more than Honda or Toyota brands.6

The largest, most versatile Subaru ever.
The Ascent is designed to adapt to the size and shape of your journey, whether it’s an everyday errand or a special
weekend outing. Its two rows of 60/40-split flat-folding seats allow for a wide range of cargo and seating configurations.
There’s also up to 75.6 cubic feet of cargo space,1 plus under-floor storage, if you need it. Though its space is expansive,
you can still feel close to your rear-seat passengers, thanks to the Cabin Connect 2 voice amplification system. And
thoughtful details like a Power Rear Gate with lock button,2 standard raised roof rails and 19 cup holders mean the
Ascent can take on whatever your day demands.
